description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Border` which extends `HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform` to transform deprecated 'border' HTML attributes into CSS styles during HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Border
classes.description: A class that transforms the 'border' attribute of HTML elements into inline CSS styles for styling purposes.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the 'border' attribute into an inline CSS style and returns the modified attributes array.
